information.description:
Lazarus Group’s post-Arasaka return to more of a PMC focus has resulted in their operators becoming some of the best “special forces for hire” in the world once more. Some claim Lazarus is much stronger than they let their competition believe, and when you face one of their soldiers in combat, you might start to believe that too.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Lazarus Group).

description.value: Experts in combat who use their fighting prowess to dominate in the lawless time of the Red.

In less turbulent times, the name Ajax would more likely be associated with the Greek hero of legend, a European soccer club or a household cleaning product. For the residents of Night City, Ajax brings to mind only one thing: Militech's assault rifle. Its engineers made not an attempt to reinvent the wheel, but only to design a durable, reliable weapon that wouldn't require months of training or high-end combat cyberware to use it. Ultimately, the engineers' vision has been realized.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).

Cost: Varies ♦ Required Slots: 1

Fits: All Pistols, SMGs, Shotguns, and Assault Rifles capable of Autofire, or which already expend more than 1 round of ammunition when fired in Single Shot

Causing armchair debates and shredding targets since 1935.

When fired in Single Shot, the weapon’s user may choose to expend 2 additional rounds of the same ammunition type in Burst Fire. When done, all expended ammunition also functions as Armor-Piercing Ammunition. If there are not enough rounds left in the magazine for Burst Fire, using Burst Fire empties the magazine as a standard Single Shot Attack. Burst Fire can still be utilized when firing Shotgun Shells. The weapon's capabilities may also be modified depending on the type of Burst Mod Internals installed.

Available Burst Mod Internals include:

  • Fixed: 100eb (Premium) — The weapon can now only be fired in Burst Fire, and is incapable of Autofire and Suppressive Fire.
  • Bimodal: 250eb (Expensive) - The weapon is now incapable of using Autofire and Suppressive Fire, but can still fire in regular Single Shot alongside being capable of Burst Fire.
  • Selective: 500eb (Expensive) — The weapon can still be fired in its regular Single Shot, Autofire, and Suppressive Fire modes in addition to Burst Fire.

When installed into a weapon that already expends more than 1 round of ammunition when fired in Single Shot, using Burst Fire adds to the total amount of rounds expended (e.g., a rifle that already expends 3 rounds when fired in Single Shot expends 5 rounds in Burst Fire).

OPTIONAL ADDENDUM: For GMs that wish to provide a slight nerf to Burst Fire, an alternative version of this attachment instead has all Burst Fire attacks use the weapon’s Autofire Range Table for the Attack Check. This works exactly the same as a Single Shot Attack, it just uses the Autofire DVs for doing so, along with all the other effects of Burst Fire.

Attachment slots: 1

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Attachment Catalog > Internal Components).

Cost: 50eb (Costly) ♦ Required Slots: 0

Fits: All Weapons

Now your iron won’t hit the dirt every time you drop it.

When the weapon is voluntarily dropped by the user, it is instead stowed without an Action. When the weapon is knocked out of the user’s hands — such as from an Aimed Shot or Critical Injury — it does not fall to the ground and remains hanging at their side. It then requires an Action to be readied before it can be drawn again.

When attempting to Grab a Sling-equipped weapon from its wielder/holder, the attacker suffers a -2 penalty to their Check to do so. While installed, the weapon is no longer Concealable.

Attachment slots: 0

The preferred pistol among Night City cops – light, wieldy, and easy on the recoil, it's perfect for taking down enemies without necessarily killing them on the spot. Thanks to its relatively small dimensions, the gun has also found a loyal following among those who prefer a concealed carry: the Lexington easily fits in a coat pocket or purse. And for design lovers, its classic 2030s frame remains stunning as ever.
